description: Per-call CDR detail: start time, ANI/DNIS, customer trunk, SIP code, release reason, billed prefix, state and rate center.

panels.description: One row per CDR leg in the selected time range. Filter by CDR source, customer trunk and SIP code above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT call_start_time AS `Start Time`, from_did AS `ANI`, to_did AS `DNIS`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Customer Trunk`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided') AS `Release Reason`, if(billed_prefix = '', '?', billed_prefix) AS `Billed Prefix`, term_state AS `State`, term_ratecenter AS `Rate Center`, entity AS `CDR Source`, callid AS `Call ID` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(toString(sip_code) = ${sip_code:singlequote}, $sip_code) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: CDR Detail (latest 1,000)

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT entity FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip ORDER BY entity
list.label: CDR Source
list.name: entity
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT entity FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip ORDER BY entity

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT orig_trunk_group_name FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND orig_trunk_group_name != '(none)' AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) ORDER BY orig_trunk_group_name
list.label: Customer Trunk
list.name: origin_trunk
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT orig_trunk_group_name FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND orig_trunk_group_name != '(none)' AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) ORDER BY orig_trunk_group_name

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT toString(sip_code) FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) ORDER BY sip_code
list.label: SIP Code
list.name: sip_code
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT toString(sip_code) FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) ORDER BY sip_code
